extra_quotes: We use JasperGold [30] as the formal verification tool and GPT-5.5 [32] as the LLM.

First, the user asks the LLM to generate the patch only from the buggy code. Second, we provide the failing assertions in addition to the buggy code to aid in the correction process. In both steps, the proposed patch is always formally verified using a model checker.
If the assertion coverage is low, it may not always be possible to get failing assertions that can aid in localization.
